description.short_caption: Hypopigmented macules on the chest and upper abdomen.
description.detailed_description: The image shows the anterior chest and upper abdomen of a patient with multiple hypopigmented macules distributed symmetrically. The lesions are well-demarcated, round to oval in shape, and vary slightly in size. The surrounding skin appears normal in color and texture. No signs of erythema, scaling, or inflammation are visible.
